title: Watch and answer
instruction: Watch the office proposal. Discuss its promises and contradictions, then negotiate a healthier arrangement

video.title: The First Guy To Ever Work In An Office

items.prompt: What is ironic about the suggestion to display a family photograph?
items.hint: Notice what the photograph is supposed to remind the employee of
items.answer: The photograph is presented as decoration, but it reminds the employee that work keeps him away from his family for most of his waking hours

items.prompt: Why don’t the proposed mornings and evenings resolve his concern?
items.hint: Compare the available time with the energy he expects to have
items.answer: He expects to be tired early in the morning and tired again after working all day, so available hours do not necessarily mean meaningful time with family and friends

items.prompt: How does the sketch undermine the promise of two days off?
items.hint: Listen to how much activity and recovery the speaker predicts
items.answer: The speaker suggests he will have energy for about one activity and then need to recover before repeating the working week

items.prompt: How would you challenge this proposal constructively and protect time outside work?
items.hint: Name one concern and negotiate a concrete change, such as hours, commuting or availability
items.answer: Example: I’m interested in the role, but the schedule leaves little energy for life outside work. Could we agree on flexible hours and clear limits on availability?
